clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers electric motor driven food-mixers. ( grinders and liquidizers ) intended for domestic use and designed for operation at voltages not exceeding 250 V. Multipurpose machines which are used together with certain accessories are also covered by this standard as far as it applies.
